description: server-info: host facts by section — system, network, memory, disks, load and more
author: Serg Parf and agent-bus contributors

system.help: kernel and host identity from uname -a

network.help: interfaces and routes from ip a and ip r

memory.help: memory and swap usage from free

disks.help: disk inventory from lsblk and filesystem space from df -h

uptime.help: uptime and load averages from uptime

cpu.help: CPU architecture and topology from lscpu

pressure.help: CPU, memory and I/O pressure from /proc/pressure

time.help: clock and synchronization state from timedatectl

virt.help: virtualization type from systemd-detect-virt; none on bare metal

health.help: disk health from smartctl -H for lsblk disk devices (root only)

sensors.help: hardware temperatures and other readings from sensors (root only)

all.help: Return every section available to this Linux account; health and sensors require root

help.help: Describe this agent and the help-config and help-secret asks
